bookkeeping.rowText: The secure-playability spec widened by `GR_SECURE_CONTRACTS`, the eighteen maps on both projects (48 rows with the smoke, four re-runs and four controls): every pair boots with zero console and page errors; secured on both projects: Pressure Garden, Blackout Ridge, Last Claim, River; on one: Devil's Alley (desktop), Seed Run (phone); twelve instrument limits (seven need an objective verb the kit lacks: Baron, Incline, Canyon Works, Fairground, Dust Flats, Gusher County, Boneyard; five could not fund their opening defences: Far Side, Low Orbit, Eclipse, Dome Basin, Old Canal); two single-project deaths with every defence built. BANKING IS NOT BROKEN: controls on today's tree and on the tree before ux-entry-robustness-1 fail identically, the game has written the secured score at secure time since `07248387a` (2026-07-22) and the spec counts only a row the click adds (F-MPP1-1, fire-authorable, with F-MPP1-4: the spec reads secureWave 0 where the engine secures at 20). Census `docs/bench/playability-secure-census-2026-09-25.md`; the eighteen status rows' second column carries the cells. The hand-driven proofs go to Astra (`sol-play-proofs-1`, queued by this landing). Engine hash unchanged {PIN}; no deploy.
